contract.intent: Extend the event schema for the artifact collapse: the artifact-locked event records an optional free-form type tag; the confirmed event accepts an optional feedback field so a gate accept persists the human's rationale (G1).
acceptanceCriteria: artifact-locked shape validates {name, path, lockSha?, type?, version?} with type as an optional string
confirmed allowlist includes feedback; a non-string feedback on confirmed is rejected (mirrors rejected)
JourneyEvent needs no interface change (top-level feedback already declared)
existing tests for the strict schema updated to cover type + confirmed.feedback
